newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt cabinet approves 83.3 bln pounds budget.
newsitem.headline: Egypt cabinet approves 83.3 bln pounds budget.

text.p: Egypt's cabinet on Saturday approved an 83.3 billion pounds ($24.5 billion) budget draft for 1997/98, up seven percent from the previous year and with a higher deficit, al-Akhbar newspaper reported on Sunday.

The draft budget, which must still be approved by parliament, foresees 76.4 billion pounds revenue, making a deficit of 6.9 billion. Spending was 77.5 billion pounds and revenue 71.1 billion in 1996/97, making a 6.4 billion pound deficit, it said.
The report said that despite the higher deficit the state did not intend to add extra "burdens", including new taxes, on nationals in the 1997/98 year starting on July 1.
